title: Considering Using AfterPay? Watch This First
summary: Creator reviews how Afterpay makes money and compares its fees, approval process, and credit-reporting practices to a credit card.

assertions.quote: the vast majority of their income is from fees that they charge to the merchants
AfterPay says its merchants get 20% higher cart conversions and a 17% increase in average basket size
you don't know ahead of time if your purchase will be approved or not, unlike a credit card with a defined credit limit
AfterPay says they don't report on-time payments or late payments to your credit bureaus
